text: In Newtonian gravity the source of the field is the mass density ρ (Poisson's equation ∇²Φ = 4πGρ). When gravity becomes geometry in GR, what replaces ρ as the source of spacetime curvature?
choices: The stress-energy tensor T_μν, encoding energy density, momentum density, and stress
The mass density ρ, unchanged from Newtonian gravity
explanation: In GR the source on the right-hand side of G_μν = 8πG T_μν/c⁴ is the full stress-energy tensor T_μν, which includes not just rest-mass energy density but momentum density and stress (pressure and shear). Mass density ρ alone is the Newtonian source and is incomplete in GR. The potential Φ and the Ricci scalar R describe the geometry, not the matter source.
